title: Academy Systems Engineer
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Description

Your Career
As an Associate Systems Engineer, you will join a cohort of recent college graduates for an immersion into Palo Alto Networks platform, automation, and cybersecurity across network, endpoint, and cloud. This program includes up to 24 months of formal technical instruction with hands-on labs, both group and individual projects, technical study, and professional skills development. As you advance through the program, you will be placed with various sales engineering teams to learn how to support customers during the pre-sales process.

While ramping on the Academy development track you will work alongside other SE teams to learn and support the other critical work with customers within the presales process. As part of your development, you will work as a technical advisor in tandem with our sales and channel partners on customer engagements, establishing relationships with customers with the goal of helping them ensure each day is more secure than the one before.

Upon completion of the program, you will have gained proven technical and professional skills, shown qualification across multiple certifications, and rotations with senior SEs to take on a field SE position in any number of cities across the US based on business needs. Our SEs are among the best in the cybersecurity industry, with a deep technical understanding of cybersecurity products, integrations, and the critical cyber threats facing our potential customers' environments.
Your Impact
Learn the technical aspects and business value of Palo Alto Networks products

Develop the skills necessary to propose cybersecurity solutions comprised of Palo Alto Networks products

Establish yourself as a trusted team member to Technical Solutions leadership and colleagues while contributing to sales wins throughout the program

Architect and propose solutions that address the identified cybersecurity problems in each customer’s unique environment

Develop presentation skills and understanding of business and technical discovery methods

Ensure ongoing customer success, support, and adoption of cybersecurity solutions

Understand and effectively differentiate against our top competitors

Identify and document specific problems with prospective and current customers which can be solved through the deployment of integrated solutions

Act as the customer advocate for any issues that require technical assistance and follow up with the customer until the issue is resolved

Continuous self-improvement and learning to maintain technical leadership of applicable technologies (SASE, XDR, public cloud, security, networking, etc.)

Qualifications (Additional Job Description)

Your Experience
4-year undergraduate degree, preferably in a business or technical field of study

Understand and effectively present complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences

Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex problems and a systematic approach to creating solutions

Effective time-management skills and study habits

Awareness and desire to learn modern cybersecurity prevention utilizing automation, cloud, endpoint, and network technologies

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$98,000.00 - $134,000.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Specialist to drive the growth of our Cortex and Cloud business across the region.

The ideal candidate will operate in a high-growth environment at scale, thrive in driving innovation, have a solid background in cybersecurity sales, and a deep understanding of security solutions. They will have a proven track record of developing strong customer relationships and executing strategies that support rapid expansion and success. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in collaboration with internal teams, engages effectively with customers, and drives revenue growth through the sale of complex solutions.

Your Impact:

- Join the fastest growing team where experience meets cutting-edge solutions
- Build and cultivate strong customer relationships, driving business growth within the region.
- Partner with the core sales team to align customer strategies and engagements with Cortex and Cloud business objectives.
- Take full ownership of leading strategic sales campaigns, sales forecasting, utilizing in-depth knowledge of sales cycles from initial contact through procurement.
- Engage in deep technical discussions beyond standard sales presentations and pitches; while translating complex technical cybersecurity solutions into clear business value propositions for customers.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including sales engineers, to provide tailored customer-centric solutions.
- Partner with Alliances to develop joint strategies, enhance customer engagement and deliver innovative solutions for existing and prospective clients.
- Travel domestically as needed to meet with customers and attend key business events.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of field sales experience focusing on key customer accounts and delivering value to Enterprise or Major-level accounts in the cybersecurity industry.
- Extensive platform selling experience in complex sales with multiple buying centers.
- Experience selling SIEM, EDR, XDR, SOC and SOAR solutions is highly preferred.
- Established trusted relationships with CIOs and CISOs with the ability to influence and drive strategic conversations
- Expertise in applying complex solution sales methodologies to drive results.
- Experience working with channel partners and a deep understanding of a channel-centric go-to-market strategy.
- Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment while collaborating effectively with sales engineers and cross-functional teams.
- Experience operating in a continuous adoption, expansion, and upsell sales motion within a matrixed sales organization is preferred
- Willingness to travel as necessary to meet business needs up to 50%

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

- /yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Motor-Vehicle Requirement: This role may require travel to and from Palo Alto Networks, Inc. business meetings and events and requires reliable transportation to do so. If a hire chooses to drive in connection with company business, the hire for this role must maintain a valid driver’s license.

本ポジションでは、Cortex XIAM（次世代AI搭載セキュリティ運用プラットフォーム）およびCortex Cloud（クラウドセキュリティプラットフォーム）の両方を担当し、企業のセキュリティ強化を支援します。世界トップクラスのSecOpsプラットフォームを搭載したCDRが組み合わさり、Cortex Cloudによるリアルタイムクラウドセキュリティの未来を切り開きます。

クラウド攻撃をリアルタイムで阻止

AIによるクラウドリスクの優先順位付け、修復の自動化、セキュリティの合理化

エンタープライズおよびクラウド向けの最も完全なSOCプラットフォームを強化

Cortex XSIAMを統合されたリアルタイム クラウドセキュリティで拡張

営業チームの主要メンバーとして、地域内の部門横断的なチームと緊密に連携し、エンドポイントセキュリティ、行動分析、SOCセキュリティ、およびクラウドセキュリティの成長を促進します。業界のトレンドと顧客のニーズの最前線に立ち続けることで、市場におけるCortex Cloudのビジネス成長を主導します。
Your Impact
既存顧客および新規顧客に対し、Cortex Cloudのソリューションを販売し、地域全体のビジネスを開発および推進

コアセールスチームと提携し、顧客戦略とエンゲージメントをマッピング

クライアントおよびパートナーと戦略的および戦術的な課題についてコミュニケーションを促進

市場戦略と目標を策定し、アカウント戦略の実行を支援

販売サイクル全体に関する詳細な知識を活用し、正確な販売予測を管理

地元のクラウドプロバイダー（AWS、Azure、Google）とのパートナーシップを活用し、共同活動を実施

クラウドセキュリティおよびエンドポイントセキュリティのトレンド、競争環境についての知識を維持し、適切な営業戦略を展開

チャネルパートナーとの強固な関係を構築・維持し、販売機会を拡大

必要に応じて国内および海外出張の可能性あり

Qualifications

Experience:
EDR/XDRを含むエンドポイントセキュリティソリューション、SIEM、SOAR、インシデント対応、脅威管理、クラウドセキュリティの3年以上の販売経験

パブリッククラウドの深い理解、およびそのアーキテクチャの独自性に関する知識

SaaSまたはクラウドソリューションの販売経験

DevOps、コンテナ/Kubernetes、CI/CD、Cloud Native技術エコシステムに関する強い理解

ベンダーでの勤務経験

顧客志向のアプローチを持ち、チャネルパートナーとの協業経験がある方(AWS、Azure、Google Cloudのクラウドプロバイダーとの関係があれば望ましい)

Skills:
優れた営業力（計画、戦略立案、資格認定、実行能力）

優れたコミュニケーションスキル（口頭および書面、日本語必須）

ターゲットアカウント営業、ソリューション営業、コンサルティング営業技術の経験

部門横断的なチーム（アカウントチーム、パートナー営業、マーケティング、カスタマーサクセス等）との協業能力

Job Summary

Your Career

We are looking for a highly motivated, results orientated Deal Desk Manager - North America to join our organization.

The primary focus of this position will be to help structure profitable and compliant transactions that address the needs of a diverse set of internal corporate customers and increase the effectiveness and productivity of our sales teams.

The right person for this job has a team player approach, the ability to work across departments with disparate needs and excels at problem solving through critical analysis and is challenged by process review and continuous improvement.

Your Impact

- Effectively work with NAM Sales to work on Majors, Sled and Federal accounts

- Provide Sr. Leadership with financial models and evaluation of deal economics, commercial terms and conditionals and operational requirements to present risk/reward profile for opportunities

- Become expert on Steelbrick quoting tools, reviewing and enforcing revenue recognition compliance for all quoting

- Key resource reviewing and approving all non-standard pricing requests that reach the level of executive manager

- Review will include financial analysis for gross margin, revenue compliance, non standard terms requests on strategic deals including Enterprise Agreements

- Partner with field sales organization to drive large deal closure, including being one-touch resource for field sales; responsible for liaising with all organizations involved in the agreement process (finance, legal, order management, etc.) on behalf of sales. Personally services as a trusted advisor to field sales on deals

- Work with cross-functional stakeholders for decision support deal solutions

- Collaborate with impacted parties to generate acceptable documents to facilitate deal closure

- Ensure required approvals, such as discounts and contractual terms, are obtained and clearly documented

- Be a sales advocate and partner to internal organizations to understand contract requirements, structure, business terms and identification of potential risks and/or opportunities that can affect performance, growth and strategic positioning

- Responsible for adherence to and compliance with policy and procedures

- Evaluate current processes and offer recommendations for areas of improvement

- Ensure that all transactions adhere to internal revenue recognition policies and operational guidelines

- Excellent customer service, taking charge to meet deadlines by communicating with cross-functional partners through email, phone, meetings, or any other method to deliver on-time

Qualifications

Required Experience:

- 7+ years experience as Deals Desk Manager (in a tech environment, in a Finance/sales operation role) or related field

- Demonstrated capability to build strong working relationships with internal business units

- Ability to work independently in fast paced environment

- Experience of data analysis, modeling and/or financial analysis

- Intermediate/advanced Salesforce and MS Excel skills are highly recommended

- Strong communication, organizational and problem-solving skills

Job Summary

Your Career

We are looking for an execution-focused architect of growth to lead our digital media strategy and content syndication engine across the EMEA region. This isn't a passive, administrative role. We need a planner who views media as a laboratory - someone who can take high-level regional campaign frameworks and turn them into highly targeted, cross-channel media plans. You will act as the engine room of demand, bridging the gap between global campaign objectives and the tactical execution required to engage complex B2B buying groups in the EMEA cybersecurity space.

Your Impact

As a Manager (Individual Contributor), you are the connective tissue between regional strategy and market reality. You won’t just manage platforms; you will orchestrate demand across the entire digital ecosystem, encompassing Paid Social, Programmatic, Search, and our scaled Content Syndication programs. By balancing operational rigor with analytical insights, you will ensure that every dollar spent across the region optimises the buyer journey and builds measurable pipeline velocity.

- Buying Group Orchestration: Move beyond the "lead." You will design media strategies that identify, engage, and progress entire Buying Groups within target accounts. You’ll connect the dots between individual signals to build a cohesive picture of account intent and readiness.

- Architect and Own the Media Plans : Lead the charge on select campaigns for EMEA media across Audio, Video, CTV, Social, Intent platforms, Content Syndication etc. You will aggressively test new channels, questioning traditional optimisation tactics to find untapped pockets of growth.

- Media Architecture & Budget Management: Maintain and update the regional Master Media Flowchart. Track daily spend pacing, manage flight dates, adjust bidding strategies, and perform monthly financial invoice reconciliations to ensure 100% budget precision across the geo.

- Content & Creative Catalyst: Use media performance data to influence the campaigns and creative teams. You’ll provide the why that helps them build high-performing assets - bridging the gap between what looks good and what drives action.

- The AdTech Visionary (POV): While you don’t own the plumbing of our AdTech stack, you’ll maintain a strong POV on our toolkit (Demandbase, DV360, etc.), identifying gaps and pushing for innovations that keep us ahead of the curve.

- Drive Automation: Propel the team toward a hands-off-the-wheel future where possible. You will identify opportunities for machine learning and automation to handle the mundane, freeing you up to focus on high-level strategy and innovation.

- Business Impact Analysis: Connect media metrics to real-world business outcomes. You’ll examine the journey from first touch to closed-won, continuously interrogating the data to ensure we are driving high-value business, not just high-volume traffic.

Qualifications

Your Experience

- Experience: 7 years of hands-on experience in B2B digital media planning and execution within the technology or SaaS sector. You’ve successfully navigated the complexities of long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying committees.

- EMEA Market Expertise: Deep understanding of the EMEA media landscape and the nuance of the local markets, balancing brand-building with the aggressive demand-gen required in B2B SaaS.

- The Toolkit: Understanding of the modern media stack - Google Marketing Platform, LinkedIn, and Intent platforms (e.g., 6Sense). Experience with CTV, Audio, and Direct/Sponsorships is essential.

- Strategic Breadth: Proven ability to influence creative and content strategy through the lens of media performance.

- Business Acumen: You understand the P&L. You can speak the language of Sales and Product as comfortably as you speak the language of CPMs and CTRs.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field of study

- Ability to integrate third-party enterprise software within complex, distributed infrastructure environments.
- Ability to travel as needed for in-person customer meetings up to 50%
- Full proficiency in English and German.

The opportunity to expand your knowledge and work on challenging projects

Qualify leads generated from Marketing programs and promotions

Job Summary

Running a branch network day to day is still too manual. When something breaks, IT teams jump between tools, read logs, and run commands one at a time to find the cause. Keeping devices patched and secure takes the same kind of effort.

We want to change that. Palo Alto Networks is hiring a Product Manager to build AI agents that handle day-to-day branch operations: finding and fixing network problems, checking security posture, and recommending software upgrades. This work is part of Strata Cloud Manager and spans our NGFW and SASE products.

This is a hands-on role. You will write the specs, design the user experience, talk to customers every week, and work closely with engineering to ship. You will also own the product strategy and help us sell it, both directly to enterprises and through partners.

What You'll Do

- Set the product strategy and roadmap for AI agents that run branch operations: troubleshooting, posture checks, configuration health, and software upgrade recommendations.
- Start from the customer's problem, not the existing workflow. Figure out which tasks admins should never have to do by hand again.
- Talk to network admins, security teams, MSPs, and support engineers to learn how branch problems are found and fixed today, and where it goes wrong.
- Write clear PRDs and user stories. Spell out what each agent does, what data it uses, when it acts on its own, and when it asks a person for approval.
- Design how people work with agents. Build mockups and prototypes yourself, and test them with customers before engineering starts.
- Make sure agents explain their findings and actions so admins can check the work and trust it.

We are a remote first team with no current expectation to travel on a regular basis. We like to meet in-person as often as we can, with opportunities to come to the London office roughly once a month, and bigger team meet-ups planned a few times a year.

Currently we’re working with Idira Secrets Management, Workload Identity, and Agentic Security product teams; developing custom integrations and navigating complex deployment environments, whilst acting as the customers embedded product and domain subject matter experts.

Where others specialise in fast and efficient product enablement, we target the most complex customer environments and use cases, requiring both broad and deep industry and domain experience. We prefer to work directly with customer teams, collaborating with stakeholders across operations, security and engineering teams.

The Role

As a Senior Cloud Native Security Architect you will repeatedly face new and difficult challenges. Your ability to remain composed and collaborative, whilst you work with your team to find solutions will be the biggest determining factor in your success in the role. Perfect execution is never our target; instead we aim to leave the customer closer to their goals and further from ambiguity, all whilst providing an exceptional customer experience.

You will be expected to:

- Lead customer engagements incl. scoping work, directing other team members, acting as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, running calls and workshops, and providing regular project updates.

- Pro-actively initiate and contribute to internal initiatives.

- Consistently apply (and confidently speak on) cloud security best practices

- Actively engage in team/group level strategy and goal setting activities.

- Act as a peer mentor to your fellow team members. incl. providing regular feedback for personal and professional development.

You will succeed in this role if you:

- Are comfortable working directly with customer stakeholders at all levels (i.e. senior management - individual contributors).

- Are able to effectively empathise with and translate between stakeholders across different domains (i.e. infosec, operations, product R&D, senior leadership).

- Enjoy working in complex (and often ambiguous) problem domains. Helping customers determine what they actually want and need, then designing and implementing pragmatic solutions to get them there.

- Show up to calls with empathy, patience, positivity, and the desire to collaborate towards shared goals.

- Easily move between different levels of abstraction (high level architecture and solution design - implementation detail and configuration).

- Enjoy learning and can quickly become a subject matter expert in previously unfamiliar domains.

- Inspire confidence and restore calm in otherwise tense or strained situations (i.e. managing unhappy customer stakeholders and high impact service outages).

- Approach challenges pragmatically, preferring actions that produce meaningful customer value over polish and philosophical alignment.

Qualifications

The Tech

We work with an extremely broad range of tools and technologies, mostly cloud centric, and often open source (i.e. CNCF projects). As such, we often take on work in domains where we’re not yet experts, and instead must learn what’s needed in the moment, relying on a set of foundational best practices to guide us.

That said, there are a few technologies that come up time and time again for which hands-on experience and a good understanding proves extremely valuable.

These are in approximate order of importance:

- Kubernetes - self-managed (Openshift, K3s, etc.) and cloud managed (GKE, Autopilot, EKS, etc.)

- Container runtimes (Docker / containerd / podman)

- SPIFFE / SPIRE (for workload identity)

- Linux / Unix operating systems (RHEL / Rocky Linux / Ubuntu / Debian)

- Cloud networking (VPCs, firewalls,network peering, VPNs)

- Cloud IAM (predominantly GCP and AWS)

- Cloud databases (Cloud SQL, Spanner, DynamoDB, Bigtable, etc.)

- Golang / Python (for gluing services and deployment scripting)

- Terraform / Crossplane / Config Connector (GCP) / CloudFormation (AWS) (for deploying and managing cloud infrastructure)

- Git (for source control)

- Github Actions / Jenkins (for CI)

- Argo CD / Flux (for CD)

- Vault / Conjur (for secrets management)

We don’t expect candidates to be experts in all of these, but a strong foundation of security best practices, and a working knowledge of Kubernetes and the major cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, etc.) will be essential. Experience with any of the others is a huge advantage.

Job Summary

As a Senior SOC Engineer within Unit 42 at Palo Alto Networks, you will drive the creation, validation, and optimization of custom detection rules and automated playbooks across our global customer base. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will collaborate closely with clients to maximize their security posture using Cortex XSIAM and Unit 42 expertise. This highly analytical role leverages your deep understanding of detection lifecycles, proactive automation, and threat intelligence to secure enterprise environments. You will architect end-to-end security lifecycles that seamlessly connect data ingestion with high-fidelity detection engineering.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the full lifecycle of custom detections and response automations, deploying them as high-fidelity Cortex XSIAM correlation rules and playbooks through a rigorous engineering process of development, testing, staging, and soft implementation.

- Drive the continuous refinement of correlation rules to ensure strict standards for performance, accuracy, and operational relevance.

- Translate Unit 42 threat intelligence research and emerging adversary TTPs into actionable, robust detection logic.

- Champion proactive automation by engineering sophisticated playbooks to resolve emerging security challenges and optimize operational workflows ahead of demand.

- Architect the end-to-end security lifecycle within Cortex XSIAM, seamlessly connecting data ingestion, high-fidelity detection engineering, and sophisticated response automation.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in a Senior SOC, Detection Engineering, or Security Architecture role utilizing SIEMs, firewalls, EDR, sandboxes, and SOAR platforms in complex enterprise environments.

- Proven mastery of the Detection Engineering lifecycle, including experience with rule testing frameworks, soft-deployment strategies, and continuous tuning.

- Demonstrated experience reviewing and QA-ing detection logic written by others, with the ability to provide constructive optimization feedback.

- Exceptional consultative and communication skills, with the confidence to guide enterprise customers through complex architectural and workflow decisions.

- Proactive engineering mindset with a track record of designing complex automation playbooks (Cortex XSOAR or similar) based on anticipated threat vectors, not just reactive requests.

- Strong background in incident response, threat hunting, and translating threat intelligence into actionable defense mechanisms.

- Software development experience with a strong proficiency in Python for security automation and scripting.

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous hands-on experience utilizing and optimizing Cortex XSIAM.

Job Summary

Palo Alto Networks is seeking an experienced NPI Hardware Reliability Engineer to join the Technical Operations Hardware Quality Engineering organization. This role will be responsible for establishing and driving hardware reliability and quality processes throughout the New Product Introduction (NPI) lifecycle for next-generation network security and firewall platforms.

The NPI Hardware Reliability Engineer will work at the intersection of Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, Test Engineering, and Operations to ensure new hardware products are designed, validated, manufactured, and launched with a high level of quality and reliability.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in hardware reliability, product qualification, failure analysis, NPI, and manufacturing processes, with the ability to translate reliability requirements into practical validation and production controls.

Key Responsibilities

NPI Reliability & Quality

- Own and execute the NPI hardware reliability strategy, milestones, and phase-gate qualification plans from early development through production ramp.
- Partner with Hardware Engineering to assess architecture, design changes, and BOMs to identify electrical, mechanical, thermal, and environmental risks early in the product lifecycle.
- Define and execute accelerated life, stress, and environmental test plans (including thermal cycling, drop/vibe, and HALT/ALT), setting sample sizes, conditions, and pass/fail criteria.
- Analyze test data and trends to validate product readiness against defined reliability targets prior to commercial release.

Failure Analysis & Corrective Action

- Lead root-cause failure investigations across NPI testing, pilot builds, and early production using structured methods (8D, FMEA, FTA, DOE, Weibull).
- Collaborate with Design, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, and CMs to implement, validate, and track closed-loop corrective actions.
- Feed field and post-mortem learnings back into early NPI cycles to prevent recurring failure modes.

Manufacturing & Supplier Reliability

- Assess supplier and manufacturing reliability risks during EVT, DVT, and PVT builds, auditing critical processes, materials, and component qualifications.
- Establish quality controls, test coverage, and containment protocols for critical hardware components and sub-assemblies.

Analytics & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Define NPI reliability metrics, statistical models, and dashboards to communicate risks and launch readiness to executive leadership.
- Act as the Technical Operations SME for hardware reliability, partnering closely with cross-functional engineering, program management, and external CM partners.

Process & Framework Infrastructure

- Build, standardize, and scale the company’s NPI Hardware Reliability framework, including templates, phase-gate criteria, and lessons-learned mechanisms across multi-hardware platforms.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 5+ years of experience in hardware reliability, product quality, NPI, manufacturing engineering, or a related discipline.
- Experience with reliability qualification and validation of complex electronic hardware.
- Strong understanding of hardware failure mechanisms and reliability engineering principles.
- Experience working with contract manufacturers and external suppliers.
- Experience with NPI processes and production ramp of complex electronic products.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Experience with structured root-cause and failure-analysis methodologies.
- Ability to interpret engineering drawings, schematics, BOMs, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Experience with networking, server, datacenter, storage, telecommunications, or cybersecurity hardware.
- Experience qualifying high-complexity systems containing PCBs, processors, memory, power supplies, thermal systems, fans, chassis, connectors, and high-speed interfaces.
- Experience with HALT, HASS, accelerated life testing, Weibull analysis, reliability prediction, and statistical analysis.
- Experience with FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, DOE, and reliability modeling.
- Experience with hardware quality systems and ISO 9001-based processes.
- Experience using data analytics and visualization tools to monitor reliability and quality performance.
- Experience with RMA / field-return analysis and incorporating field lessons into NPI.
- Experience leading cross-functional technical projects without direct authority.

Precision Equipment: Knowledge and operation of Vector Network Analyzers (VNA), Oscilloscopes, Digital Multimeters (DMM), Programmable AC/DC Power Supplies.

Python Programming: Demonstrated ability to write scripts for test automation.(Required)

Passive Component Characterization: Advanced understanding of capacitors (MLCC, Tantalum, Polymer) and inductors, specifically their frequency-dependent characteristics (ESR, ESL) and DC/AC bias effects.

4. Experience working in new product development teams. Networking product experience preferred.
